content.comment_body: Good evening, I've been using a [product_name] device with article number [article_no] for over a year without issues. Now, I purchased two new units with article number [article_no]. I'm working with [product_name] V[version_no] software. Both new devices have firmware version [version_no]. My PC is linked to the device using a standard Cat6 network cable. IPs are as follows: - PC: 192.168.0.13 - [product_name] BM: 192.168.0.3 - [product_name] TDE: 192.168.0.2 All devices share subnet 255.255.255.0 and gateway 192.168.0.1. The software detects both the TDE and BM; connection test for TDE passes, but not for BM. Strangely, both new devices show this problem. Using my old device, with the same IP configuration, everything works fine. I tried moving the SD card from the old unit to the new ones; the program runs, yet I still can't connect these devices to my computer. Any ideas? Thank you for the support!

To communicate with your [product_name] devices, you need the latest [product_name] V[version_no] software. The devices with firmware version [version_no] are the newest models. The V[version_no] software does not recognize this newer hardware.
You can download the upgrade to [product_name] V[version_no] from [url].
Thank you for your quick response! Your help is much appreciated. Greetings from Belgium.

analysis.insight_summary: Users working with newer [product_name] devices featuring updated firmware faced connection difficulties when using older versions of [product_name] software. The hardware and network configuration were otherwise identical, but connection to the new devices failed while the older model worked correctly. Users were not aware that ensuring compatibility between software versions and device firmware is necessary, resulting in confusion until advised to update their software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect new [product_name] devices to operate in the same way as older versions without needing software updates. They also anticipate straightforward communication between their PC and devices using the current setup.
